title: CRAFT Prompt Design Framework: A Professional Methodology for Writing Better AI Prompts
description: Learn how the CRAFT Prompt Design Framework helps professionals write structured AI prompts using Context, Role, Action and Format. Includes practical examples from software development, cybersecurity, healthcare, finance, marketing and education.

sidebar.title: Stay Updated
sidebar.description: Get the latest AI and cybersecurity insights directly in your inbox.

sections.heading: What is the CRAFT Prompt Design Framework?
sections.description: The CRAFT Prompt Design Framework is a structured methodology that helps users write high-quality AI prompts. Instead of asking vague questions, CRAFT provides enough business context so AI understands the objective, behaves like the correct expert, performs the required task and returns the response in the desired format.

sections.heading: Why Most AI Prompts Fail
sections.description: Many users simply ask AI a question without providing context. The AI has to guess the audience, business objective, technical level and expected output. This often produces generic answers.

sections.heading: C - Context
sections.description: Context explains the business problem and provides all background information.

infoBox.title: SEO Example
infoBox.description: Improve my website. → I own AIKavach, an AI and Cybersecurity training platform. I want to improve SEO, AEO and AI Search visibility.

sections.heading: R - Role
sections.description: Tell AI who it should become before answering.

sections.heading: A - Action
sections.description: Action defines exactly what AI should perform.

sections.heading: F - Format
sections.description: Format controls how AI returns the answer.

sections.heading: Complete Example
sections.description: Below is a complete enterprise prompt using CRAFT.

infoBox.title: Example Prompt
infoBox.description: Context: I own AIKavach... Role: Senior SEO Consultant... Action: Analyze my website... Format: Executive Report with JSON, Tables and Roadmap.

sections.heading: Key Takeaways
sections.description: A strong prompt should always include necessary context, role, action, and format to guide the AI effectively.
